title: Finite oracle nondeterministic machine
statement: A finite oracle nondeterministic Turing machine over a symbol alphabet consists of a natural number of ordinary work tapes, a finite state type with decidable equality, and an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine with those states and one additional query tape. Its query state and its two answer states are pairwise distinct.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of ordinary work tapes, with one additional query tape
An underlying oracle nondeterministic Turing machine
The query and two answer states are pairwise distinct
